pairs.subject: render-mount-pipeline
pairs.evidence: desk/src/landing/LandingTV.tsx:32 The landing delegates its component tree to React and browser layout, and repository searches found no renderUnit, mountBinder, incrementalMount or recyclePool implementation requiring this pipeline.

techniques.evidence: desk/src/landing/themes/blueprint/drawings.tsx:22 Drawings produce ordinary React/SVG trees; the standard explicitly excludes layout managed by a document runtime or declarative toolkit.
desk/src/design/desk-landing.css:19 This fixed stage has no scrolling viewport that incrementally acquires or releases render units.
desk/src/landing/themes/blueprint/Blueprint.tsx:112 The decorative animation uses React effect cleanup; there is no custom binder system or independently detached retained-host lifecycle.

desk/src/landing/themes/blueprint/Blueprint.tsx:251 The app drawings remain in the mapped React tree and change transform or opacity; no visibility window competes with focus or transitions over mountedness.

desk/src/landing/themes/blueprint/Blueprint.tsx:167 Title fitting reads browser layout inside useLayoutEffect, rather than joining a background layout computation with checkpoints and multiple waiter classes.
desk/src/tv/landingRows.ts:18 The landing displays a bounded set of app objects, with no heterogeneous scrolling item stream or recycling pool to key by leaf content type.
